AdChannelCard._note: childOrder is degenerate — positions 1 and 2 are both generic <Flex> (icon box, content column), so this snapshot only catches a regression that swaps the action <Box> with either <Flex>, not an icon/content swap. Root cause: no named sub-components, just Chakra primitives. Real protection for icon-vs-content order still relies on the code comment + this JSON file's textAlign/RTL evidence, not on this childOrder check.

CampaignCard._note: childOrder is degenerate — root has 2 generic <Flex> rows (header, footer), so this only catches a header/footer swap. NO `justify` field here on purpose: layout-diff checks every justify-bearing element against one flat value, and CampaignCard legitimately has two different correct values — outer header Flex justify=space-between (first child=TitleGroup at start/right, last child=MenuTrigger at end/left) and nested TitleGroup Flex justify=start (right-aligns title+badge within its own flex box). Any single value here false-positives on one of the two lines — verified 2026-08-03 (tried 'start', then 'space-between', both flagged one real line as wrong). This granularity gap is a known layout-diff limitation; protection for both justify values relies on the code comment only, not this snapshot. footer row internal order = [startDate(first=rightmost), endDate(middle), status(last=leftmost)] — reversed from raw Figma LTR canvas order (status, endDate, startDate) per rightmost-visual=first-DOM-child rule. INCIDENT 2026-08-03: nested TitleGroup was originally shipped with justify=end (LTR intuition) which resolves to LEFT under RTL — content hugged the left edge next to the menu button instead of the card's right edge. Fixed to justify=start. Never copy justify=flex-end assuming it means right under RTL.

CampaignTable._note: columns FIRST-to-LAST = name(rightmost) → startDate → endDate → status → actions(leftmost). Reversed from raw Figma LTR canvas column order (actions, status, endDate, startDate, name).
